rows.answer: 发展主义把经济增长、工业能力与国家建设连接起来，国家工业化则把资本、产业与基础设施集中到长期转型目标。相似工具在不同社会却产生不同结果。 差异不能只归因于政策名称。执行能力、财政约束、市场规模、教育、治理、国际环境与历史路径都会改变同一种政策工具的实际作用。 [1][2]
这些能力同时创造依赖。供应路线、能源价格与关键节点一旦受扰，远方社会也可能承担成本；连接因此既扩大能力，也把局部冲击传播到更大范围。 文明结构最终会进入空气、住房、交通、工作、收入与生活成本。生活环境决定日常基础条件，就业把个人接入社会资源与职业路径，收入与必要成本之间的余量则影响家庭缓冲和转换能力。 [1][2]

Developmentalism linked economic growth, industrial capacity and state-building, while state-led industrialization concentrated capital, industry and infrastructure around long-term transformation goals. Similar instruments nevertheless produced different outcomes across societies. The differences cannot be explained by policy labels alone. Implementation capacity, fiscal constraints, market scale, education, governance, international conditions and historical paths all change how the same instrument works in practice. [1][2]

These capabilities also create dependence. Disruption to routes, energy prices or key nodes can transmit costs to distant societies, so connection expands capacity while also widening the reach of local shocks. Civilizational structures eventually enter daily life through air, housing, transport, work, income and living costs. Living environment shapes basic conditions, employment connects people to resources and career paths, and the margin between income and necessary costs affects household buffers and capacity to change. [1][2]
